_comment: OPT-IN token/cost/latency telemetry. Merge this `env` block into the host repo's .claude/settings.json to make Claude Code export per-session usage (input/output tokens, cost, and duration) over OpenTelemetry. This is how you get TRUE per-agent token+cost: each agent run is its own session/trace, and service.name lets you group a whole pipeline execution. Requires an OTel collector/backend reachable at the endpoint (run one locally → your metrics store, e.g. Cloud Monitoring / Grafana / Honeycomb). Latency alone (no collector) is available deterministically from GitHub Actions run durations via adlc-cost.sh.
